card.name: Inside compound medical terms
card.fires_on: The middle or second part of a multi-part technical term, such as dissociation, carbon monoxide detectors, or controlled-release tablets. It marks the spot where a known compound phrase continues.

modes.label: Split medical words
modes.description: Partway through a long chemical or medical word, just before the rest of it.

modes.label: Release or detector after a modifier
modes.description: The second half of a hyphenated or compound product term, such as extended-release or carbon monoxide detector.
modes.example: Naproxen Sodium Controlled-<<Release>> Tablets are contraindicated

modes.label: Noun after a named subject
modes.description: A noun like distribution or detector following a named subject.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of familiar compound terms like carbon monoxide detector or controlled-release tablets.
